title: Pachmann’s nocturne beside Frank Lévy
work: Nocturne in D-flat major, Op. 27 No. 2
question: How differently can the same returning melody unfold across an early electrical disc and a modern piano recording?
intro: Pachmann recorded the nocturne on his own Baldwin piano at Hayes on26 June 1925; its HMV DB 860 issue was already reviewed in The Gramophone that December. The review praises the performance’s spirit while observing uneven recorded sonority and explicitly says he does not speak on the disc. Frank Lévy’s Musopen recording supplies the modern timeline reference. The files run about4:36 and 6:18, but musical alignment—not raw duration—is needed to compare the same returning phrase.
